title: chromolaena laevigata var. arenaria
intro: Chromolaena laevigata var. arenaria, commonly known as smooth leafy joe pye weed, is a plant species of the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its multiple health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Chromolaena laevigata var. arenaria include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
